answer_1.quote: We build on top of two earlier surveys that looked at hallucinations generally within NLG.

answer_3.quote: LLM-as-a-judge evaluations have emerged as an alternative to human evaluation due to their lower cost.

answer_4.quote: we identify 64 human evaluations of hallucination and extract key information on how evaluations are conducted
answer_4.guideline: definition of hallucination, annotation type (e.g., categorisation, Likert-scale), the NLP task in question, availability of annotated data, annotator demographics...compensation, annotation quality assurance measures, interannotator agreement (IAA) details, the annotation user interface used, and annotation guidelines
